records.title: TRM Labs — October 29 Binance multi-chain security incident and XRP outflow analysis
records.note: TRM reports approximately USD6.36B transferred from Binance-attributed wallets across ten blockchains. It identifies 233.46M XRP transferred from five Binance wallets on XRPL to one attacker-controlled address between 20:05 and 20:09 UTC on October 29. TRM says the XRP remained in place at its October 30 00:30 UTC observation cutoff. TRM attributes the incident to TraderTraitor/North Korea with high confidence based on on- and off-chain intelligence; this is TRM's attribution, not a Binance-published root cause or a separate law-enforcement finding. Binance had not published its root cause in the report.

records.title: B-Agent PR #1371 — make scheduled cross-analysis read-only on current main
records.note: Draft pull request based exactly on main 653b66de9a9545bc756a34385972f06038229783. It restricts cross-analysis to contents:read, disables persisted checkout credentials, preserves six generated outputs as a 30-day artifact, removes git staging/commit/pull/push, and adds five regression tests registered in core CI.
